description_en: Queries the list of servers affected by baseline check item risks
description_zh: 查询基线检查项风险影响的机器列表
name: ListCheckItemWarningMachine

parameters.help_en: The ID of the check item
parameters.name: check_id

parameters.help_en: The category to which the check item belongs
parameters.name: risk_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the check item. Default value: null. Valid values:

1: failed
2: verifying
3: passed
6: ignored
7: fixing
8: fixed
parameters.help_zh:
检查项状态。默认为null。取值：

1：未通过
2：验证中
3：已通过
6：已忽略
7：修复中
8：已修复
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match keyword for servers
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The name of the container security query parameter
parameters.help_zh: 容器安全查询参数名称
parameters.name: container_field_name

parameters.help_en: The value of the container security query parameter
parameters.name: container_field_value

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。起始值为1。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to display on each page during paging in a paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave the PageSize parameter empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group to query.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130972.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产分组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130972.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The data source. If you leave this parameter empty, the baseline check results for servers are queried by default. Valid values:
default: server
agentless: agentless
parameters.help_zh:
数据来源，为空时默认查询主机基线结果。取值：
default：主机
agentless：agentless
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

schema.description_en: The paginated list of servers with alerts

List.description_en: The list of servers with alerts

AssetType.description_en: The type of the cloud service asset

AuthVersion.description_en:
The authorization version of the asset. Valid values:

1: Free Edition
6: Anti-virus Edition
5: Premium Edition
3: Enterprise Edition
7: Ultimate Edition
10: Value-added Service Edition
AuthVersion.description_zh:
资产的授权版本。取值：

1：免费版
6：防病毒版
5：高级版
3：企业版
7：旗舰版
10：仅采购增值服务版

Bind.description_en:
Indicates whether the asset is bound to an authorization. Valid values:

true: The asset is bound to an authorization.
false: The asset is not bound to an authorization
Bind.description_zh:
资产是否已绑定授权。取值：

true：已绑定授权
false：未绑定授权

FixList.description_en: The list of fixable baselines in which the risk of this check item is detected
FixList.description_zh: 检出此检查项风险的可修复基线列表

items.description_en: The fixable baseline in which the risk of this check item is detected
items.description_zh: 检出此检查项风险的可修复基线

RiskName.example: Alibaba Cloud Linux/Aliyun Linux 2 Baseline for China classified protection of cybersecurity-Level II

FixStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether fixing is supported. Valid values:

0: not supported
1: supported
FixStatus.description_zh:
是否支持修复。取值：

0：不支持
1：支持

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the server

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the server instance

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the affected asset instance
InternetIp.description_zh: 受影响资产实例的公网IP地址

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the affected asset instance
IntranetIp.description_zh: 受影响资产实例的私网IP地址

LastHandleTime.description_en: The timestamp of the latest handling of the check item risk on the server. Unit: milliseconds
LastHandleTime.description_zh: 该机器的检查项风险的最新处理的时间戳，单位为毫秒

LastScanTime.description_en: The timestamp of the latest scan. Unit: milliseconds
LastScanTime.description_zh: 最新扫描的时间戳，单位为毫秒

PortOpen.description_en:
Indicates whether the server has ports open to the Internet. Valid values:

true: The server has ports open to the Internet.

false: The server does not have ports open to the Internet
PortOpen.description_zh:
该服务器是否有端口对公网开放。取值：

true：服务器有端口对公网开放

false：服务器无端口对公网开放

Prompt.description_en: The check prompt for the baseline check risk item
Prompt.description_zh: 基线检查风险项的检查提示
Prompt.example: There is a weak password (username/password): root/he*****34

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the asset resides

Status.description_en:
The status of the check item. Valid values:

1: failed
2: verifying
3: passed
6: ignored
7: fixing
8: fixed
Status.description_zh:
检查项状态。取值：

1：未通过
2：验证中
3：已通过
6：已忽略
7：修复中
8：已修复

TargetId.description_en: The ID of the scan target

TargetName.description_en: The name of the scan target

TargetType.description_en:
The object type. Valid values:

ECS_SNAPSHOT: snapshot
ECS_IMAGE: image
TargetType.description_zh:
对象类型。取值：

ECS_SNAPSHOT：快照
ECS_IMAGE：镜像

WarningRiskList.description_en: The list of baselines in which the risk of this check item is detected
WarningRiskList.description_zh: 检出此检查项风险的基线列表

items.description_en: The baseline in which the risk of this check item is detected
items.description_zh: 检出此检查项风险的基线

RiskName.example: Alibaba Cloud Linux/Aliyun Linux 2 Baseline for China classified protection of cybersecurity-Level II

PageInfo.description_en: The pagination information of the query results

Count.description_en: The number of affected assets returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 查询到的受影响资产的当前页显示数据条数

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page during paging in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries displayed on each page during paging in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of affected assets returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的受影响资产的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
